statements.statement: Plan is at least two budgets for the school and two for the town: a non-override budget and an override budget (maybe two); the school must have a budget for if the override doesn't pass.

At the tri-board meeting a straw vote was taken on a multi-override: a core services budget plus a restoration budget; the town appears to be creating a core services and a restoration budget as well.

warnings.about: school budget presentation / cuts if override fails
warnings.condition: if the school presents only a dollar figure and no cuts
warnings.prediction: Residents given only a dollar figure won't know what a vote against the override means in cuts; the school should present cuts so people vote on something real.

warning: EXTRACTED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL FROM MACHINE CAPTIONS. Every figure is as heard and may be misheard; every line carries the second in the video, which is the record.
